name: Medusa v2 Commerce Store (Backend + Storefront)
description: Headless e-commerce with admin, Next.js storefront, search and workers.

PORT.description: HTTP port Medusa listens on (also used by the Railway healthcheck).

MEDUSA_WORKER_MODE.description: This instance only serves HTTP; background jobs run on the Worker service.

DISABLE_MEDUSA_ADMIN.description: Keep false here: this service builds and serves the admin dashboard at /app.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string over the private network.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis for sessions, events, workflows, locking and cache; family=0 enables IPv4+IPv6 lookup.

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign auth tokens. Generated; shared with the Worker.

COOKIE_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign session cookies. Generated; shared with the Worker.

MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL.description: Public URL of this backend (admin and API).

STORE_CORS.description: Origins allowed to call the Store API (the storefront domain; comma-separate extra domains).

ADMIN_CORS.description: Origins allowed to call the Admin API (the admin is served from this domain).

AUTH_CORS.description: Origins allowed to call the auth routes (admin and storefront).

MEDUSA_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Login email of the first admin user, created on first deploy. Change it to your own address before deploying.

MEDUSA_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first admin user (generated). Only used to create the user; change it later in the admin.

STOREFRONT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Shared token the Storefront uses to fetch the publishable API key from /internal/publishable-key at start.

SEED_DEMO_PRODUCTS.description: Set to true to add 50 extra demo products on the next deploy (idempotent). The base demo store is always created on first migration.

S3_FILE_URL.description: Public base URL for uploaded files: the Media-Proxy service, because Railway Buckets are private.

S3_BUCKET.description: Bucket name used for the S3 API (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_REGION.description: Bucket region (Railway Bucket reference, usually auto).

S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 API endpoint of the Railway Bucket (public network only).

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Bucket access key ID (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Bucket secret access key (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Set to true only for older Railway Buckets that require path-style URLs (see the bucket's Credentials tab).

MEILISEARCH_HOST.description: Meilisearch URL over the private network. Clear it (Backend and Worker) to use Medusa's built-in PostgreSQL search instead.

MEILISEARCH_API_KEY.description: Meilisearch key used by the backend to manage and query indexes.

STRIPE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Stripe secret key; enables the Stripe payment provider (then enable it per region in the admin).

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. Stripe webhook signing secret for <backend URL>/hooks/payment/stripe_stripe.

PORT.description: Port of the worker's internal /health endpoint (used by the Railway healthcheck).

MEDUSA_WORKER_MODE.description: Process subscribers, scheduled jobs, workflows and search indexing; no public HTTP.

DISABLE_MEDUSA_ADMIN.description: The worker does not build or serve the admin dashboard.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string over the private network.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection (same instance as the Backend).

JWT_SECRET.description: Same JWT secret as the Backend.

COOKIE_SECRET.description: Same cookie secret as the Backend.

MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL.description: Public backend URL, for links generated by background jobs.

MEDUSA_SERVER_HEALTH_URL.description: The worker waits for this URL before starting, so it never runs before the Backend's migrations.

WAIT_FOR_SERVER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Maximum wait for the Backend health URL before starting anyway.

S3_FILE_URL.description: Same public file URL as the Backend.

S3_BUCKET.description: Bucket name used for the S3 API (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_REGION.description: Bucket region (Railway Bucket reference, usually auto).

S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 API endpoint of the Railway Bucket (public network only).

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Bucket access key ID (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Bucket secret access key (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Same URL style setting as the Backend.

MEILISEARCH_HOST.description: Same Meilisearch URL as the Backend (indexing runs on the worker).

MEILISEARCH_API_KEY.description: Same Meilisearch key as the Backend.

STRIPE_API_KEY.description: Same Stripe configuration as the Backend (optional).

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Same Stripe webhook secret as the Backend (optional).

PORT.description: HTTP port of the Next.js server.

NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL.description: Public backend URL used by the browser and the server (applied at container start).

NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this storefront, used for absolute links and metadata.

NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_REGION.description: Fallback country code; must belong to a region in Medusa (the demo region covers gb, de, dk, se, fr, es, it).

MEDUSA_INTERNAL_URL.description: Backend URL on the private network, used only at start to fetch the publishable API key.

NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Optional override (pk_...). Leave empty to fetch the key from the Backend automatically.

KEY_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Maximum time to wait for the Backend at start before the container exits and restarts.

NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY.description: Optional. Stripe publishable key; build-time value, redeploy after changing it.

S3_BUCKET.description: Bucket name used for the S3 API (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_REGION.description: Bucket region (Railway Bucket reference, usually auto).

S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 API endpoint of the Railway Bucket (public network only).

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Bucket access key ID (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Bucket secret access key (Railway Bucket reference).

S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Same URL style setting as the Backend.

CACHE_CONTROL.description: Cache-Control header for served files (Medusa file keys are unique per upload).

ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES.description: Comma-separated content-type prefixes the proxy serves; other objects return 404.

PORT.description: Port Meilisearch listens on (used by the healthcheck and the Backend URL).

MEILI_HTTP_ADDR.description: Listen on all IPv4/IPv6 interfaces for the private network.

MEILI_MASTER_KEY.description: Master key protecting the Meilisearch API (generated).

MEILI_ENV.description: Production mode: requires the master key and disables the search preview UI.

MEILI_DUMP_DIR.description: Dump directory on the volume (used for upgrades and backups).

MEILI_MAX_INDEXING_MEMORY.description: Upper bound for indexing memory so the container stays within its RAM budget.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis
